about-outline:
Protected VPN is an app for a secure connection to the internet through your own VPN server. It uses the Shadowsocks protocol.

Built on open-source software (Apache License 2.0).
add-access-key-dialog-help-text: Je, unahitaji ufunguo mpya? Unda ufunguo kwenye {openLink}tovuti yetu{closeLink}.
auto-connect-dialog-detail: Protected VPN itaunganishwa kiotomatiki wakati mwingine utakapozima kisha kuwasha upya kifaa chako isipokuwa ukitenganisha kutoka kwenye seva yako ya Protected VPN.
contact-view-exit-billing: Timu ya Protected VPN haipokei malipo. Tafadhali wasiliana na mtu aliyekupatia ufunguo ili ushughulikie tatizo hili.
contact-view-exit-cannot-add-server: Timu ya Protected VPN haiwezi kusaidia ikiwa unataka kuweka seva. Tafadhali jaribu hatua za utatuzi zilizoorodheshwa {openLink}hapa{closeLink} kisha uwasiliane na mtu aliyekupatia ufunguo ili utatue tatizo hili.
contact-view-exit-connection: Timu ya Protected VPN haiwezi kukusaidia kutatua matatizo ya kuunganisha kwenye seva. Tafadhali jaribu hatua za utatuzi zilizoorodheshwa {openLink}hapa{closeLink} kisha uwasiliane na mtu aliyekupatia ufunguo ili utatue tatizo hili.
contact-view-exit-no-server: Timu ya Protected VPN haisambazi funguo zinazolipiwa au zisizolipiwa. {openLink}Pata maelezo zaidi kuhusu jinsi ya kupata ufunguo.{closeLink}
contact-view-exit-open-ticket: Kwa sasa tunapokea maombi mengi ya usaidizi kwa wateja na tunakushukuru kwa kuwa na subira. Tafadhali usitume ombi jipya linalohusu suala hili. Ikiwa una maelezo ya ziada ambayo ungependa kutoa, tafadhali jibu barua pepe ya awali kuhusu ombi hili.
contact-view-intro: Tueleze jinsi tunavyoweza kukusaidia. Tafadhali eleza tatizo lako kwa kina na usiweke taarifa binafsi ambazo hujaombwa hapo chini.
contact-view-issue-cannot-add-server: Ninatatizika kuweka seva nikitumia ufunguo wangu
contact-view-issue-connection: Ninatatizika kuunganisha kwenye seva yangu ya VPN ya Protected VPN
contact-view-issue-managing: Ninahitaji usaidizi wa kudhibiti seva yangu ya VPN ya Protected VPN au kusaidia wengine kuunganisha kwenye seva hiyo
contact-view-issue-performance: Muunganisho wangu wa intaneti ni hafifu ninapounganisha kwenye seva yangu ya VPN ya Protected VPN
contact-view-open-ticket: Je, una tiketi ambayo haijashughulikiwa inayohusu tatizo hili?
error-connection-configuration: Mipangilio si sahihi. Piga picha ya skrini ya maelezo ya hitilafu na uyatume kwa mtoa huduma wako wa ufunguo.
error-connection-configuration-fetch: Imeshindwa kupakua mipangilio ya seva. Piga picha ya skrini ya maelezo ya hitilafu na uyatume kwa mtoa huduma wako wa ufunguo.
error-connection-proxy: Imeshindwa kuunganisha. Tafadhali kagua muunganisho wako wa intaneti, kisha upige picha ya skrini ya maelezo ya hitilafu na uyatume kwa mtoa huduma wako wa ufunguo.
error-feedback-submission: Samahani, hatukuweza kutuma maoni yako. Tafadhali hakikisha kuwa umeunganishwa kwenye intaneti kisha ujaribu tena.
error-invalid-access-key: Ufunguo usio sahihi. Tafadhali jaribu tena au tuma maoni ili upate usaidizi.
error-server-incompatible: Samahani, ufunguo huu hauoani na toleo hili la Protected VPN.
error-timeout: Inaonekana muunganisho unachukua muda mrefu kinyume na ilivyotarajiwa. Kufunga na kuwasha upya kunaweza kusaidia. Tatizo hili likitokea tena, tafadhali tuma maoni.
error-unexpected: Samahani, hitilafu ambayo haikutarajiwa imetokea. Kufunga na kuwasha upya kunaweza kusaidia. Tatizo hili likitokea tena, tafadhali tuma maoni.
feedback-thanks: Asante kwa kutusaidia kuboresha huduma! Tungependa kusikia kutoka kwako.
non-system-vpn-warning-detail: Vivinjari vingi huunganishwa kiotomatiki na Protected VPN, vingine haviunganishwi.
outline-plugin-error-admin-permissions: Protected VPN inahitaji ruhusa za msimamizi ili ianzishwe. Ikiwa huna ruhusa za msimamizi, tafadhali jaribu tena baada ya kuzima kisha kuwasha upya kompyuta yako au uombe usaidizi wa msimamizi wa mfumo wako.
outline-plugin-error-antivirus: Inaonekana kama programu yako ya kingavirusi inatuzuia kuunganisha kikamilifu.
outline-plugin-error-invalid-server-cred: Inaonekana kuwa ufunguo wako si sahihi. Hali hii ikitokea tena, tafadhali wasiliana na mtu aliyekupa ufunguo.
outline-plugin-error-routing-tables: Hatukuweza kuweka mipangilio kwenye majedwali ya kisambaza data. Tatizo hili likitokea tena, tafadhali wasiliana nasi.
outline-plugin-error-server-unreachable: Inaonekana hatuwezi kuunganisha kwenye seva yako. Tafadhali hakikisha kuwa umeunganishwa kwenye intaneti kisha ujaribu tena.
outline-plugin-error-system-configuratio: Samahani, inaonekana programu ya Protected VPN haijasakinishwa vizuri. Tafadhali jaribu kuisakinisha tena. Hatua hii isipotatua tatizo, tafadhali tuma maoni kupitia programu.
outline-plugin-error-udp-forwarding-not-: Inaonekana kuwa seva hii hairuhusu usambazaji wa UDP. Hali hii ikitokea tena, tafadhali wasiliana na mtu aliyekupa idhini ya ufikiaji.
outline-plugin-error-unsupported-routing: Inaonekana VPN nyingine inatumika. Tafadhali itenganishe na ujaribu tena.
outline-plugin-error-vpn-permission-not-: Protected VPN inahitaji ruhusa yako ili kuweka mipangilio ya muunganisho wa VPN kwenye seva. Tafadhali jaribu tena au utume maoni ikiwa unahitaji usaidizi.
outline-services-installation-confirmati: Tutaanzisha Protected VPN, hatua ambayo inaweza kuhitaji ruhusa za msimamizi. Je, ungependa kuendelea?
outline-services-installation-failed: Kwa bahati mbaya, hatuwezi kuanzisha Protected VPN, tafadhali tuma maoni kupitia programu.
outline-services-installed: Umeanzisha Protected VPN, tafadhali jaribu tena kuunganisha kwenye seva.
privacy-text: Baadhi ya maelezo ya kiufundi yanatumwa ukituma maoni, ikiwa kuna hitilafu au tukio la programu kuacha kufanya kazi au ikiwa msimamizi wa seva yako akichagua kushiriki data ya matumizi ya seva isiyojulikana.
privacy-title: Protected VPN haitakusanya taarifa zako binafsi
proclient-device-hint: A unique ID of this device. It stays the same after reinstalling the app and is sent to the panel with the subscription request, so it can limit the number of devices.
proclient-server-delete-hint: Press and hold a server to rename or remove it
proclient-server-not-responding: The server is not responding. Choose another one
proclient-set-failover-desc: If the server stops responding, switch to the next best one
proclient-set-killswitch-desc: In Android settings turn on “Always-on VPN” and “Block connections without VPN” for Protected VPN, so traffic never goes around the VPN
proclient-set-launch-desc: Connect to the chosen server, or the best one (Auto), when the app opens
proclient-set-ping-desc: Measure all servers' ping when the app starts
proclient-set-refresh-desc: How often to download the server list from the panel
proclient-set-test-desc: After connecting, check that the internet works through the server
proclient-subscription-delete-confirm: Remove this subscription and all its servers?
proclient-subscription-empty: This subscription has no Shadowsocks servers
proclient-test-fail: Failed: no response through the server
proclient-test-tap-connected: Connected. Tap to test the connection
server-add-instructions: Nakili na ubandike ufunguo ili uweke seva.
server-add-invalid: {openLine}Ufunguo usio sahihi.{closeLine}Weka ufunguo sahihi (ss://) ili uweke seva.

server-detected: Tafadhali thibitisha kuwa unataka kuweka seva hii.
support-form-outreach-consent: Ndiyo, ningependa kujisajili ili kufahamishwa kuhusu fursa za kushirikiana.
update-downloaded: Toleo lililosasishwa la Protected VPN limepakuliwa. Litasakinishwa utakapozima kisha kuwasha upya Protected VPN.
proclient-server-moved: The server moved to a new address — connecting to it
proclient-recovering: Server not responding, updating the subscription…
